# Reverend Ez

## Overview

- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v3 c24 P3](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0003), [v3 c24 P9](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0009)</sub>
- **Role:** Clergyman / Minister  <sub>[v3 c24 P9](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0009), [v3 c24 P14](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0014), [v3 c24 P15](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0015), [v3 c27 P29](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0029)</sub>
- **Titles:** Rev.  <sub>[v3 c39 P39](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0039)</sub>; Reverend Ez  <sub>[v4 c3 P9](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0009), [v4 c3 P43](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0043)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Ez  <sub>[v3 c27 P21](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0021)</sub>

## Appearance

He is described as an extremely unattractive young man with a large, gangly frame and long legs. He has limp, flaxen hair, green eyes, a large mouth, a scholarly forehead, and impassioned eyes. His voice, however, is delightful and charming.

_Sources: [v3 c24 P10](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0010), [v3 c24 P11](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0011), [v3 c24 P15](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0015)_

## Personality

He possesses great beauty of soul and nature, demonstrating a deep, serious, gentle, and faithful dedication to his calling as a clergyman. He is bright, friendly, and frequently laughs and jokes with others. He offers thoughtful guidance and approaches his work in the slums with selflessness and enthusiasm.

_Sources: [v3 c24 P11](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0011), [v3 c24 P12](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0012), [v3 c24 P15](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0015), [v3 c24 P17](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0017), [v3 c27 P25](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0025), [v3 c39 P39](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0039)_

## History

While studying theology at St. Columbia, Ezra Hale spent a summer in charge of the Point Prospect Mission Church, where he met Cressida Lindsay. Despite initial hesitation about entering the ministry, he embraced his calling and delivered moving sermons at the village church. During his studies, he visited Cressy at Tabby's Place in Wexcombe and eventually proposed to her. Following his graduation from St. Columbia, he took charge of a small mission church in the Tanner Street slums. He married Cressy the following June, after which they went on a saunter through the land of Evangeline before taking up residence in the slums. Together they had children, and he later attended the wedding of Hugh and Nell, offering a beautiful wedding prayer during the service.

_Sources: [v3 c24 P9](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0009), [v3 c24 P15](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0015), [v3 c24 P19](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0019), [v3 c25 P12](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0012), [v3 c27 P19](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0019), [v3 c27 P29](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0029), [v3 c39 P39](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0039), [v3 c39 P40](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0040), [v4 c3 P43](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0043), [v4 c3 P44](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0044), [v4 c4 P16](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0016)_
